label: Myth vs fact
description: Each slide names a common belief, then what the facts say instead.

label: N things nobody tells you
description: A numbered list of things students learn too late, one per slide.

label: This or that
description: Two choices side by side, with what each one means for the reader.

label: Step by step
description: One thing to do per slide, in the order to do it.

label: Informative, one idea per slide
description: A clear explainer: each slide makes one point and backs it with a fact.

label: Bullet points
description: Short points under a heading, quick to scan on a phone.

label: A day in the life
description: One student's day, morning to night, with the facts along the way.

label: Question and answer
description: The questions students ask, each answered from the facts.

label: Before you go (checklist)
description: What to sort out before you leave, as a list to tick off.

label: Then vs now (timeline)
description: How things changed over time, from what was to what is now.
